author: @jeremyfowers

evidence.api_compatibility: No breaking changes. The modification is internal to the GUI component BackendManager.tsx — new entries in RECIPE_LABELS and ENGINE_LOGOS records, a minor rework of the className template to branch on logo.showName, and two new CSS classes. No API, CLI, config, or protocol surface is touched.
evidence.documentation: No user-facing documentation changes required. This is a cosmetic GUI addition (logo images and display styling) and does not alter documented behavior, config options, CLI commands, or API contracts.
evidence.manual_release_testing: No human has exercised this change. The PR depends on lemonade-sdk/assets#17 to supply the actual logo images; the PR body notes 'Requires to lemonade-sdk/assets#17 to merge before the assets will show up in the app.' CI is a build check, not end-to-end verification that the logos render in the GUI backends tab. The two new CSS classes (.backend-card__logo--icon with padding-block and 38px max-height) and the showName-driven class logic have not been visually confirmed on a live build.
evidence.post_approval_commits: No commits were added after approval. The first and latest approval timestamps are both 2026-11-05T15:40:40Z. The branch contained four commits at the time of merge, all authored by @jeremyfowers with Claude Opus 5.5 co-authorship.
evidence.review: One approval from @danielholanda with the comment 'Looks great. Just please make sure to merge the assets of first (no approval needed).' @danielholanda is not listed as a maintainer in docs/dev/contribute.md and has no listed subject area in GUI, app, or design language. Subject area expertise for GUI belongs to @kpoineal (GUI, app, a11y, Windows, LemonAIde) and @fl0rianr (GUI, ci). The PR was merged with only one approval from a non-expert reviewer, which does not meet the contribute.md guideline that 'PRs should have at least one reviewer with subject area expertise.'
evidence.security: No security concerns. The change references external image URLs from the already-trusted raw.githubusercontent.com CDN path for engine logos. No credential handling, network calls, code execution, or supply-chain changes.
evidence.tests: No tests are present. The change is purely UI display code (React component props and CSS class logic). There are no tests weakened or deleted; this category is N/A for a visual-only addition.
